Hey guys, kya flat ka rent deposit limit discuss kar sakte hain?
Haan, mujhe bhi pata karna hai. Kya koi specific limit hai?
Mujhe suna hai ki kuch jagah 10k lete hain, par mujhe toh zyada nahi dena.
True, 10k toh bahut zyada hai. Kya hum kuch negotiate kar sakte hain?
Mere dost ka kehna hai ki 5k har jagah normal hai.

Kya hum sab ek baar flat dekhne chale?

Weekend pe toh sab free hain. Best time hai.
Thik hai, flat dekhne ke liye time fix kar lo.
Sounds good! Main time note kar leti hoon.
Perfect. Flat ka location share kar dena.
Haan, location pe bhi discussion hona chahiye.
Chalo, sab milke dekhte hain. Hope for the best!
Bilkul! Let's find a good place.
